caption: The drawing depicts a puppet figure positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The puppet wears a long, flowing red cloak that reaches the ground, and a matching red pointed hat with a bit of a twist at the top. Around its neck is a ruffled yellow collar, which stands out against the darker red garment. The puppet’s face appears grayish with some shading and has pronounced features including dark, arched eyebrows, round black eyes, a pointed nose, and red lips. The hands are visible, extending from the sleeves and colored in a similar grayish tone to the face. No other objects or background elements are present; the focus is solely on the colorful puppet centered within the composition.
title: Punch as Clown
